conf.description: Carbon Black EDR watchlist/feed hit, CEF via server rsyslog templates. Not recommended - Broadcom documents the CEF extension dictionary as lossy for this product; only templated keys are recovered, the rest lands in msg.

conf.comment: cef function is a serializer only; CEF is parsed here with regex_extract for the pipe header plus serde kvp for the extension blob.

functions.description: split the CEF pipe-delimited header from the extension blob; not anchored to the line start so any leading syslog priority/timestamp/host prefix is tolerated
parse the space-delimited key=value CEF extension into its templated keys

fname always mapped to process.executable (see README gap: the process/binary template signature-id split is not implemented), cast segment id, set event.dataset, drop consumed/unmapped header scratch fields
batch rename of the templated CEF extension keys
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
